stimulus.text: Original secondary passage written for this question. In 1493, the pope drew a line through the Atlantic giving Spain the lands west of it and Portugal the lands east. Portugal objected, since the line left it little room in the Atlantic, and in 1494 Spain and Portugal signed the Treaty of Tordesillas, moving the line 370 leagues west of the Cape Verde islands. The new line gave Portugal Brazil and kept Spain's claim to the rest of the Americas.

parts.prompt: Identify one term of the Treaty of Tordesillas.
Explain why Spain and Portugal accepted the pope's role in dividing the lands.
Explain one consequence of the treaty for Portugal.

instruction: Answer each part in your own words from the stimulus only. Do not open the question file.
